players.product: Liquid cooling, power distribution units, enclosures and electrical connection/protection for AI data centers

quarterly_data.signal: nVent entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Maverick Power, a North American provider of engineered power distribution and infrastructure solutions for data centers, including low-voltage switchgear and switchboards, medium-voltage switchgear, integrated modular solutions, and services. Maverick Power is headquartered in McKinney, Texas, has approximately 900 employees in Texas and Arizona and estimated 2026 revenues of approximately $700 million; the release says the business has a strong backlog and future demand visibility. The deal adds a power distribution platform complementing nVent's data center offerings and expands its offerings for new power architectures and system-level solutions and services for data centers. Chair and CEO Beth Wozniak: Maverick Power 'brings strong power distribution expertise and broadens our offerings to data center customers'. nVent expects the acquisition to be accretive to adjusted EPS in the first year after completion; closing is expected in the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to customary closing conditions including regulatory approval.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 900 employees; estimated 2026 revenues approximately $700 million; close expected in the fourth quarter of 2026
